subject: Biology
title: Biodiversity and Conservation
summary: Biodiversity (Edward Wilson ne term popular kiya) teen levels par hai: genetic, species aur ecological diversity. Lagbhag 1.5 million species describe hui hain; kul ka andaza lagbhag 7 million tak (Robert May).

India ke paas duniya ka sirf 2.4% land area par 8.1% species diversity hai — 12 mega-diversity deshon mein se ek. Diversity tropics mein sabse zyada aur poles ki taraf kam hoti hai (latitudinal gradient).

Alexander von Humboldt ka species–area relationship: area ke saath species richness ek had tak badhti hai. Biodiversity ka loss aur extinction 'Evil Quartet' se hota hai: habitat loss aur fragmentation, over-exploitation, alien species invasions aur co-extinctions. IUCN ki Red Data Book threatened species record karti hai.

Conservation in situ (hotspot, protected areas — national park, sanctuary, biosphere reserve — sacred groves, Ramsar wetlands) ya ex situ (zoos, botanical gardens, seed banks, cryopreservation) hota hai.

formulas.name: Levels of biodiversity
formulas.formula: genetic (Rauwolfia vomitoria — reserpine variation; India has 50,000+ strains of rice and 1000 varieties of mango);  species (Western Ghats have more amphibian species than Eastern Ghats);  ecological (India's deserts, rain forests, mangroves, coral reefs, wetlands, estuaries and alpine meadows)

formulas.name: Global species proportions
formulas.formula: more than 70% of recorded species are animals; plants (including algae, fungi, bryophytes, gymnosperms, angiosperms) are about 22%;  among animals insects are 70% (7 of every 10 animals)

formulas.name: Species–area relationship
formulas.formula: log S = log C + Z log A  (S = species richness, A = area, Z = slope, C = Y-intercept)
formulas.note: Poore continents jaise bahut bade areas ke liye Z kahin zyada steep (0.6–1.2) hota hai.

formulas.name: Z values
formulas.formula: Z ≈ 0.1–0.2 for small areas regardless of taxonomic group or region;  frugivorous birds and mammals in tropical forests across continents: Z ≈ 1.15

formulas.name: Why tropics are richer
formulas.formula: long evolutionary time (undisturbed for millions of years);  less seasonal, more constant environment (niche specialisation);  more solar energy → higher productivity

formulas.name: Evil Quartet
formulas.formula: habitat loss and fragmentation (Amazon rain forest — 'lungs of the planet');  over-exploitation (Steller's sea cow, passenger pigeon);  alien species invasions (Nile perch in Lake Victoria; Parthenium, Lantana, Eichhornia; African catfish Clarias gariepinus);  co-extinctions (host fish and its parasites; plant–pollinator)

formulas.name: Recent extinctions
formulas.formula: dodo (Mauritius), quagga (Africa), thylacine (Australia), Steller's sea cow (Russia);  three subspecies of tiger: Bali, Javan, Caspian;  last 500 years: 784 extinctions (IUCN 2004)
formulas.note: IUCN Red List (Red Data Book) threatened species ko critically endangered, endangered aur vulnerable jaisi categories mein record karti hai.

formulas.name: Rivet popper hypothesis
formulas.formula: Paul Ehrlich: the ecosystem is an aeroplane and species are rivets — losing a few may not matter, but losing key ones (on the wings) threatens the whole system
formulas.when: Species ka khona kyun maayne rakhta hai.

formulas.name: Biodiversity hotspots
formulas.formula: high species richness + high endemism;  34 hotspots worldwide (less than 2% of land area);  India: Western Ghats and Sri Lanka, Indo-Burma, Himalaya

formulas.name: Protected areas in India
formulas.formula: 14 biosphere reserves, 90 national parks, 448 wildlife sanctuaries;  Ramsar sites protect wetlands of international importance

formulas.name: Sacred groves
formulas.formula: Khasi and Jaintia Hills (Meghalaya), Aravalli Hills (Rajasthan), Western Ghats (Karnataka, Maharashtra), Sarguja, Chanda and Bastar (Madhya Pradesh)

formulas.name: Ex situ conservation
formulas.formula: zoos, botanical gardens, wildlife safari parks;  cryopreservation of gametes (−196 °C);  in vitro fertilisation;  tissue culture propagation;  seed banks

formulas.name: International efforts
formulas.formula: Earth Summit, Rio de Janeiro (1992) — Convention on Biological Diversity;  World Summit on Sustainable Development, Johannesburg (2002) — reduce biodiversity loss by 2010

examples.title: Area dugna karna
examples.problem: Z = 0.2 ho to area dugna hone par species richness kitne guna badhti hai?

examples.title: India ka hissa
examples.problem: Duniya ke land area aur species mein India ka kitna hissa hai?
examples.solution: 2.4% land area aur 8.1% species diversity — mega-diversity desh jahan 45,000 se zyada plant aur unse dugni animal species record hain.

examples.title: Lake Victoria
examples.problem: Nile perch ne Lake Victoria par kya asar daala?
examples.solution: Lake mein laaye jaane ke baad isne 200 se zyada native cichlid fish species ko extinct kar diya — alien species invasion.

examples.title: Co-extinction
examples.solution: Jab host fish species extinct hoti hai, uske unique parasites bhi extinct ho jaate hain. Waise hi plant aur uska obligate pollinator ek doosre par nirbhar hain.

examples.title: Biodiversity kyun bachaayein?
examples.problem: Conservation ke teen tarah ke arguments batao.
examples.solution: Narrowly utilitarian (khaana, fibre, dawaayein — 25% se zyada drugs plants se), broadly utilitarian (ecosystem services; Amazon forest photosynthesis se kul O₂ ka lagbhag 20% banata hai) aur ethical (har species ki apni keemat hai).

topics.title: Number of species
topics.explain: IUCN (2004) ke hisaab se describe kiye gaye plants aur animals 1.5 million se thode zyada hain. Robert May ne duniya mein lagbhag 7 million species ka andaza lagaya. Bahut si species abhi khoji nahi gayi, khaaskar prokaryotes, insects aur tropical species mein.

topics.title: Importance of species diversity
topics.explain: Zyada species wali communities zyada stable hoti hain — David Tilman ke lambe plot experiments ne dikhaya ki zyada species wale plots mein saal-dar-saal biomass ka utaar-chadhaav kam aur productivity zyada thi.

topics.title: Amazon rain forest
topics.explain: Isme shayad millions species hain, jisme 40,000 se zyada plants, 3000 fish, 1300 birds, 427 mammals, 427 amphibians, 378 reptiles aur 1,25,000 se zyada invertebrates.

topics.title: Biopiracy and bioprospecting
topics.explain: Bioprospecting economic importance ke products ke liye molecular, genetic aur species-level diversity ki khoj hai. Biodiversity mein ameer desh bioprospecting se faayda utha sakte hain.

topics.title: Loss rate
topics.explain: Abhi species extinction rates insaan se pehle ke samay se 100 se 1000 guna tez maane jaate hain; 12% birds, 23% mammals, 32% amphibians aur 31% gymnosperms par extinction ka khatra. Ecologists sixth mass extinction ki chetaavni dete hain.

topics.title: Effects of biodiversity loss
topics.explain: Plant production mein girawat, drought jaise environmental jhatkon ke prati kam resistance, aur plant productivity, water use, aur pest aur disease cycles jaise ecosystem processes mein zyada utaar-chadhaav.

ratta: log S = log C + Z log A;  Z 0.1–0.2 (small areas), 0.6–1.2 (continents).
Evil Quartet: habitat loss, over-exploitation, alien invasions, co-extinction.
34 hotspots;  India: Western Ghats–Sri Lanka, Indo-Burma, Himalaya.
